tagline: Find any file path on any host — and tag where it lives.
problem: The paths a scanner finds reveal where software actually lives — a vulnerable library, a copied binary, an app outside the package manager. Finding every host with one path shouldn't need SQL.
does: Explorer › Paths searches the filesystem paths found on assets by path text, with the plugin that found each and the host and IP. Tag applies Path : <name> to every asset carrying that exact path.

glance.caption: Explorer › Paths's results: each path with its plugin, host and IP, and a Tag button per path.

capabilities: by any part of the path.
the plugin, host and IP for each path; the host opens Asset Dossier.
Path : <name> on every asset with that exact path, with an editable value, behind the write gate and a confirm.
send the rows through Notify & Report.
how: Explorer › Paths reads the filesystem paths in your local navi.db without changing it; results page on the server, 20 rows a page (up to 50). Tags go through navi's tag-by-query.
who: Analysts locating a file or package across hosts, and owners checking where their software is deployed.
better: Custom App Discovery turns unnamed paths into Custom App tags, Exposure Routes maps paths to owners, and Explorer › Routes does the same for application routes.
cta: Type a path — Explorer › Paths finds every host it lives on.
